claim.value: Small numbers may prevent obtaining a reproducible result.
claim.scope: A possible limitation on the available observation, not a finding that the factor lacks an effect.

provenance.rationale: The span identifies small numbers as a possible obstacle to reproducibility and explicitly excludes concluding that the factor has no effect.

signal_basis.value: Compare missing-attachment frequency across comparable orders using a consistent inspection interval. Observe a reduction after responsibility becomes explicit, with repetition across comparable periods if volume permits, recording eligible-order and missing-attachment counts.
signal_basis.scope: The prospective attachment comparison and its capacity to demonstrate a reproducible response with the available order volume.

provenance.rationale: These spans specify the comparison, observed reduction, volume-qualified repetition and relevant counts.
This component applies only to CONDITIONAL_WARRANT judgments.

rationale: Even when the comparison is executed and a reduction observed, few eligible orders can leave too little information to demonstrate repeatability. This licenses the stated possibility without implying that the factor has no effect.
uncertainty: No minimum count is specified, so the claim supports a possible limitation rather than a determination that this observation is insufficient.
